mutations.name: historical success unbounded: the snapshot freshness boundary is removed, so a Pro/trial success outlives a downgrade
refreshed denial preserves the old success: the P2-4 root cause is re-introduced
mutations.anchor: account.capabilities[key] = { ok: false, lastCheck: Date.now(), reason: 'not_entitled' };
mutations.replacement: if (account.capabilities[key]?.reason !== 'success') account.capabilities[key] = { ok: false, lastCheck: Date.now(), reason: 'not_entitled' };

mutations.name: failures share the eviction order again: a failure burst erases the billed window and zeroes its summary
